tool.about: Discover accelerator Programs and compare them with your company profile. Saved fit results are shared with colleagues who have full document access. Review current details on each Program's official website.

common.readOnly: You can read saved fit results, but your role cannot run matching.
common.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
common.accessBody: Accelerators is available only to active company members with access to all company documents and the required document permissions. Ask a company administrator to review your access.

home.title: Accelerator Programs
home.description: Explore sourced Programs and your company's saved fit results. Opening this screen never starts paid matching.
home.matchHint: Matching compares all available Programs with the current company profile. A fit score is not a probability of acceptance.
home.profileMissing: Build the company profile in Settings → Company before matching Programs.
home.emptyBody: A trusted installation operator must import reviewed Program records. There are no sample or automatically generated results here.

fit.title: Company fit
fit.staleHint: The company profile or Program changed since this result. Click Match Programs to update it; no rematch happens automatically.
fit.unmatchedHint: No saved fit assessment. Matching starts only when you choose Match Programs.

program.noCycles: No Cycle information has been confirmed.
program.portalNote: Confirm current dates and requirements on the Program's official website or application portal.

run.pollFailed: Could not refresh matching progress. The run may still be in progress.

errors.runInProgress: A company run is already starting or running. Wait for it to finish before matching Programs.
errors.fullAccess: Accelerators requires access to all company documents.
errors.profileRequired: Build the company profile before matching Programs.
errors.notFound: This Program or matching run was not found.
errors.conflict: The saved data changed. Refresh and try again.
errors.invalid: The matching request is not valid.
errors.credits: There are not enough credits for matching.
